title: Convert PDF to Excel Online Free: Extract Tables Into Spreadsheets
description: Turn PDF tables into Excel online free with ChooseTools. Detect rows and columns in your PDF and download a formatted .xlsx spreadsheet right in your browser with full privacy.

sections.heading: Tables Locked Inside PDFs, Finally Usable
paragraphs: PDFs preserve layout at the cost of editability — a well-formatted table becomes a frozen snapshot you cannot open in a spreadsheet program. [pdf-to-excel:Converting PDF to Excel] unlocks those rows and columns.
Re-typing table data is slow and error-prone. Automated conversion keeps the numbers, headings and structure intact while saving you from transcription mistakes.
ChooseTools reads the PDF text layer in your browser, groups the words by their position into rows and columns, and builds a genuine .xlsx workbook.
No uploads, no accounts and no watermarks: the file never leaves your device and the resulting spreadsheet is immediately editable.

sections.heading: How to Convert PDF Tables to Excel in Three Steps
paragraphs: The conversion is a single-file workflow that finishes in seconds for typical documents.
Drop your PDF into the upload area. The tool reads every page, groups words into table cells by their positions, and produces a formatted .xlsx workbook you can download.
The output keeps reading order across pages, so multi-page tables land in one continuous worksheet.
Digital PDFs convert instantly; the free tool needs no configuration for standard table layouts.

sections.heading: Spreadsheet Output Instead of Copy-Paste Fragments
paragraphs: Copying a table from a PDF reader usually yields scrambled cells and lost alignment. Position-aware extraction preserves which words belong to which row and column.
The generated workbook uses real cells, a bold header row and auto-sized columns, so it opens cleanly in Excel, Google Sheets, LibreOffice and online editors.
Numbers stay numbers where possible, keeping the spreadsheet useful for sums, filters and pivot tables.
That structure is exactly what analysts need before further steps: cleaning data, combining sheets or feeding a reporting pipeline.

sections.heading: Archiving Reports, Invoices and Statements
paragraphs: Financial statements, invoices, inventories and sales reports are routinely distributed as PDFs — right where you need the underlying data.
With local conversion you can extract numbers from confidential financials, payroll data and supplier records without staging anything on a third-party server.
The results interoperate with the rest of the suite: [excel-to-csv:export to CSV], [excel-to-json:turn the sheet into JSON] or [csv-to-excel:restyle as Excel] afterwards.
Accountants, admins and analysts turn locked quarterly reports into greppable, sortable spreadsheets in seconds.

sections.heading: Scanned Documents Need an Extra Step
paragraphs: Not every PDF carries a text layer. Scanned tables are images inside a PDF shell, so there are no words to arrange into cells.
For those files, run the pages through the OCR-capable image flow first to bring the words out of the scan, then convert the digital version here.
Digital PDFs convert immediately with no configuration, keeping the workflow simple for the common case.
Whether born-digital or scanned, the goal is the same: your table data in a spreadsheet where it belongs.

sections.heading: Why Local Table Extraction Wins
paragraphs: Cloud converters force you to upload documents that may contain sensitive figures, client names and personnel records.
Local extraction means none of that leaves your machine. The .xlsx you download is yours alone — no watermark, no server log, no account.
It runs the same on Windows, macOS, Linux and mobile, so secure conversion is available anywhere you work.
For legal, financial and HR files, that on-device guarantee changes what you are willing to automate.

sections.heading: From PDF Table to Spreadsheet in One Local Loop
paragraphs: Once your table is a real spreadsheet, the document suite turns the surrounding work into one local loop: [csv-json:convert formats], [json-to-excel:rebuild sheets] and [convert-image:clean image exports].
Free conversion hands you a fully local office pipeline for the data-heavy documents you handle every week.
The bottom line: PDF tables stop being cages for your data — every row becomes reusable, sortable and yours.
Every stage stays on your machine, so the full loop from locked PDF to editable spreadsheet remains private, fast and entirely free.

faqs.a: Yes. Conversion runs entirely in your browser; the PDF is read locally and produces an .xlsx workbook without any upload to a server.
Yes. Words are grouped into rows and columns based on their positions on the page, and the result keeps reading order across all pages.
